name: The Northern Pylon
label: Quest
description: The Northern Pylon: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: What could they be for? I can't get the thought out of my head!
It's driving me crazy -- that the rumors I have heard about the crystal pylons are all true. Call me gullible, but I'll usually believe anything people tell me.
Anyway, I have heard that there is one of the crystal pylons fairly close. Somewhere in the north... Please locate it, friend. I just know they exist.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you visited the pylon, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I know the stories are true, friend.
